text:
ashwin: quick q — can we settle on span naming + attrs for LLM requests? I'm seeing inconsistent keys across runtime/console exporters.

maria: +1. We need a canonical set for model, tokens, cache, routing, and rollout flags. Also need privacy/retention rules before we export.

joey: proposal: top-level span.name = `llm.inference.request`, child spans like `llm.inference.exec` for model compute. Standard attrs:
- `llm.model.name`
- `llm.model.revision`
- `llm.model.variant`
- `llm.prompt_token_count`
- `llm.completion_token_count`
- `llm.total_token_count`
- `llm.cache.hit_count` (int)
- `llm.cache.prefix_hit` (bool)
- `llm.batch.size`
- `llm.routing.policy`

sylvia: ops will push back on introducing `llm.` vs existing `inference.` prefix. We have other services using `inference.*` already.

ashwin: fair. compromise: canonical prefix `llm.inference.*` so it's discoverable and distinct from embedding/inference pipelines.

samir: critical privacy note: DO NOT export raw prompt text or token content. We can export counts and a prompt hash (sha256) to correlate, e.g. `llm.prompt_hash`. Also strip user identifiers from telemetry unless tenant opts in.

maria: agree. Suggested attributes for privacy:
- `llm.prompt_hash` (sha256 hex)
- `llm.prompt_token_count` (int)
- `llm.user_tenant_id` (hashed, optional)

joey: exporter mapping: OTLP collector should map `llm.*` into telemetry namespace and tag with `service.name=redwood-inference` and `route.id`. Retention defaults: traces 30d for hosted, 365d for enterprise, metrics 90d. Make retention per-tenant configurable.

ashwin: sampling policy proposal: always sample errors, sample 0.1% of successful requests, and always sample canary/rollout traffic. Add `llm.sampling.reason` attr with values `error|canary|sampled|not_sampled`.

sylvia: cache semantics: k-v cache is per-session; attributes should include `llm.cache.hit_count` and `llm.cache.prefix_hit`. For batching we need item-level details — suggest child spans per item with `llm.batch.index` and `llm.batch.size`.

ops-bot: deploy: telemetry-config v1.3 rolled to staging @ 2024-11-12T03:12Z :rocket:

samir: pattern suggestion for span.name: use dotted tokens for easy search: `{domain}.{operation}.{phase}` -> `llm.inference.request` / `llm.inference.exec` / `llm.inference.kvcache_lookup`.

maria: can someone draft a short RFC? I'll consolidate examples, exporter mapping, retention table, and privacy checklist. We need legal sign-off on retention+hashing.

joey: example payload for implementers:
```
span.name = "llm.inference.request"
attrs = {
  "llm.model.name": "redwood-7b",
  "llm.model.variant": "int8-onnx",
  "llm.prompt_token_count": 48,
  "llm.completion_token_count": 192,
  "llm.total_token_count": 240,
  "llm.cache.hit_count": 2,
  "llm.routing.policy": "latency-pref",
  "llm.prompt_hash": "ab12...ef34",
  "llm.sampling.reason": "canary"
}
```

ashwin: ok thanks — action items: @maria to draft RFC, @joey to update OTLP exporter mapping and collector config, @sylvia to update console dashboards to use `llm.inference.*` fields. We'll review RFC in telemetry sync tomorrow 10:00 PT. :+1:
